run_doctest_back_reference: run the doctest suite that validates Boost.Python back reference extension bindings for Y and Z classes
test_y_constructor: test the Y class constructor by creating an instance with an integer argument and checking instance count
test_z_constructor: test the Z class constructor by creating an instance with an integer argument and checking instance count
test_copy_y: test the copy_Y function by copying a Y instance and verifying the instance count increments
test_y_identity: test the y_identity function by passing a Y instance and asserting it returns the same object
